description: This file defines a singly linked list implementation with methods to add, remove, get size, and retrieve elements by index. It includes an internal Node class and utility functions for list traversal.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list class with methods to manipulate list elements.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: An internal class representing a node in the linked list, holding a String data and a reference to next node.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at the specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Private helper method to unlink a node from the list, adjusting previous node's next reference.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Private companion object method to find the last node of the list starting from head.
